maddeler.e:
نتخلخل (form IIq)
# نَتَخَلْخَلُ (nataḵalḵalu) /na.ta.xal.xa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَلْخَلَ (taḵalḵala)
# نَتَخَلْخَلَ (nataḵalḵala) /na.ta.xal.xa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَلْخَلَ (taḵalḵala)
# نَتَخَلْخَلْ (nataḵalḵal) /na.ta.xal.xal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَلْخَلَ (taḵalḵala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
